notes: Read SKILL.md and references/cli-contracts.md in full. Vendor-authored (skill-author: Paperzilla Inc) guide to the `pz` 0.7.1 CLI: list projects, browse/search project feeds with careful pagination, read canonical papers and recommendations (JSON/markdown), leave recommendation feedback, and generate Atom feed URLs; the reference maps each command to the HTTP routes it uses.

Medium: install commands use the vendor's Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket (SKILL.md:44, 54-55; unpinned) and, only if Homebrew 6 rejects the formula, `brew trust --formula paperzilla-ai/tap/pz` scoped to that single formula (SKILL.md:47-49); `pz login` uses an email OTP and stores session tokens in ~/.paperzilla/tokens.json (SKILL.md:89-97, cli-contracts.md:10-15); all commands call paperzilla.ai with the user's session. `pz feedback` changes account data and is gated on user request (SKILL.md:198); `--atom` can create a feed token. Acceptable because it is the user's own account and service, there is no curl|sh installer, and the skill warns not to send tokens to an arbitrary PZ_API_URL, not to log/publish Atom URLs, and never to export the tokens file (SKILL.md:227-244, cli-contracts.md:26-27, 79-81).

Users must hold a Paperzilla account with CLI access; the skill notes 0.7.1 requires login even for canonical papers despite online docs. Linux install and source builds are pointers to official docs/repo, not bundled. The `brew trust` step relaxes a Homebrew trust check for one formula; users should decide whether to allow it.
